summary: Fluid sizing is done entirely in CSS. The HTML is a normal page with a header and a paragraph; the CSS makes their sizes follow the window width.
notes: There are no extra classes for small or large screens. One rule covers every width.
The viewport meta tag is still required so phones report their real width.
Open the page in a browser and resize the window to watch the heading change size.
pitfall: Making a separate copy of a heading for phones and hiding one of them. Screen readers may read both.
